## Activity

During July 2025, North City Eye Clinic completed 479 captures. This activity represents the total number of image captures recorded for the reporting period. The available information indicates that session lists ran as planned apart from routine leave. The service therefore maintained its planned capture activity during July 2025, with the recorded workload covering all captures submitted for review.

## Image quality

Of the 479 captures, 12 were ungradable. The ungradable rate was 2.5. These images could not be used for grading and are included in the reported total. Image quality performance should continue to be monitored through routine review of ungradable images and the associated rate.

## Grading

A total of 131 results were graded referable. The median grading wait was 1 day. This figure represents the median lag for grading during July 2025. The referable results and grading lag are reported alongside the capture and image-quality measures to provide a concise view of activity at North City Eye Clinic.
